subject: Fix random element in skewed sparse hash table (#2085)
reason: The change only alters how hashtableFairRandomEntry/hashtableSampleEntries pick a random entry in a sparse/skewed hash table: fewer samples when sparse and a fresh random cursor per scan iteration. This is a performance-and-fairness fix to an internal random sampler with no deterministic observable behavior change.
